plugin.name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 Fusion Fix
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. Higher rates may affect gameplay. 0 is unlimited; -1 uses the monitor refresh rate.
ResX.description: Use 0 for the desktop resolution. Set both dimensions to override it.
ResY.description: Use 0 for the desktop resolution. Set both dimensions to override it.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the fix menu language. Auto uses English. Reopen Plugins to apply.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the publisher and studio logos and the intro movie at startup. The intro stays available in Options > Movies. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Gameplay field-of-view multiplier on top of widescreen correction. 1.0 preserves the intended framing. Fixed and scripted camera views are excluded.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Auto puts the score and special meter at the left screen edge and the stance icon at the right edge; centered elements stay centered. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps them inside a centered box of that shape (4:3 to 32:9). Nothing is stretched.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
MAIN_ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. Released while unfocused, dragging or using system menus. Turning this off releases it immediately.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings to their shipped defaults. Press again to confirm.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply changed startup settings.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then press twice to apply it to this plugin.
checkupdates.description: Check for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Plugins; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for Tony Hawk Pro Skater 3 Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for Tony Hawk Pro Skater 3 Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
